text: では　さっそく　＊に　＊を　でんじゅ　いたそう…　きっ…　きえええぇぇええいっ！！
note: きえええい is a kiai, the sharp shout a Japanese martial artist gives when striking, so the old man sounds like a master passing on a secret technique. The English game replaced it with a growl-like howl.
claim: Kiai is a short shout uttered in Japanese martial arts when performing an attacking move.

check.quote: In Japanese martial arts a kiai (Japanese: 気合) is a short shout uttered when performing an assault.
